page.notes: The woodcut vignette at the left of the opening lines is an illustration with no text; it is not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page and a handwritten or stamped mark at the top right are excluded. The "S. P. D." greeting is set as a paragraph, not a heading. The mark after "optimi" and the mark after "ipsosq" are printed abbreviation or reference signs, copied as seen; their exact form is uncertain. The Greek word "εὐλογίας" is read from a small image and is doubtful. The signature at the foot is hard to read and is marked [?]. The word "cofcriptis" is read as "conscriptis" with the long s written as a plain s; the reading is doubtful.
